title: Market Semantics Scoring
description: Implement score_market_context() using TradingCalendar, NorthboundFlow, IndexConstituent.
acceptance_criteria: TradingCalendar validates target_date is trading day
NorthboundFlow boosts score for large inflows
IndexConstituent filters universe to tracked indices
implementation_notes: Use is_trading_day() for validation (returns empty list if not trading day)
Use northbound_to_signals() for northbound flow signals
Market data unavailability returns (0.5, 'Market data unavailable')
